result.summary: Found 2 issues on the page: one major layout/content rendering bug and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, the delivery time and delivery fee text appear to be overlapping or corrupted, rendering as '25-3⓪delivery' instead of something like '25-35 min delivery'. The '€0 delivery' badge text seems to be bleeding into or conflicting with the delivery time label beneath the restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time label and the delivery fee badge are rendered in separate, non-overlapping DOM layers. Review z-index, absolute positioning, or text concatenation logic to prevent text collision in the restaurant card subtitle area.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll list ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, and its card is partially clipped at the screen edge, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text-overflow: ellipsis styling to the restaurant name label so truncation is clean and intentional, clearly signaling to the user that the list is scrollable.
